title: Announce feature
description: The 15 to 45 second feature announcement or changelog video, in the manner of Linear, Notion and Slack: what changed, why it matters, show it, where to find it. Covers naming the feature in the first six words, frame-budgeted beat sheets for 15, 20, 30 and 45 seconds with VO word budgets, the cursor, before-and-after and focus-push patterns with house timings, the CTA that points at the toggle, sound per interaction, and recuts for an in-app loop, a changelog embed and a vertical social clip. Load it for one feature or a small set, not a whole-product launch.
summary: The 15–45 s changelog video: name it in six words, why it matters, show it on the real UI, point at the toggle.

requires.why: The real feature footage or screens the whole video is built on.
The what-changed and why-it-matters lines, said plainly.
One sound on each interaction that matters.
A bed under the VO, or the track for a music-led social cut.
Legibility of the new control and the peak's state change are frame checks.
Loudness of the export and the loop check on the in-app cut.

route.deliverable: A 15–45 second announcement of one shipped feature: what changed, why it matters, the feature working, where to find it
askFirst: Which feature, and what can the user do now that they couldn't before?
Where does it play: changelog embed, in-app, or social?
Is there a screen recording or screenshots of it?

models.note: Plain and present-tense, like a real changelog entry.
